title: The Spiritual Man, the Wisdom Unfolding, the Foundations of Doctrine
description: What the descending truth meets in its receiver. T10 — the spiritual man whose glory is the whole structure of the divine outgoing taken up as his own members; the rational with the Calling and Hearing manifest within it. T11 — the litany of "origin" statements tracing every gift, every blessing, every counsel, every act of building, every loosening, every wisdom back to the specific divine register from which it issues. T12 — the five foundational sayings that ground the rational in the names of the Lord, making one body, living, of all that the soul has received.
